evidence: ACTOR SUBSTITUTION DISCLOSED: the dedicated review-reliability subagent in this runtime has no Bash tool and cannot execute the contract-mandated read-only Git inspection against the frozen trees. This report was produced by a shell-capable substitute running the SAME provider-selected R3 lens under the identical read-only recipe. No other lens was substituted or merged.

Recipe honored on every command: the environment was cleared with env -i, HOME pointed at a nonexistent directory, locale pinned with LC_ALL and LANG, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM and GIT_ATTR_NOSYSTEM set, system and global Git config disabled, and Git invoked in the session repository with --no-replace-objects plus core.attributesFile, core.excludesFile and core.autocrlf disabled. --no-ext-diff was passed on every diff and --text --diff-algorithm=myers --no-indent-heuristic on every selective diff. No --binary, no worktree, index or HEAD read, no checkout, and no piping of candidate bytes through another command.

Discovery: diff --no-ext-diff --name-status 73080c8 1f780fc gives M engine/assets/assets_test.go; A engine/skills/ondisk.go; A engine/skills/ondisk_test.go; M openspec/specs/anti-generic-design/spec.md. --numstat gives 95/0, 174/0, 215/0, 26/4. The manifest matches the 4 declared paths exactly; all 4 were inspected in the declared order.

One deviation self-reported and reverted: an early command redirected a cat-file read of the overlay entrypoint script into a scratchpad file. The file was deleted immediately with rm -f before being read, no candidate bytes were consumed from it, and all subsequent inspection used git grep -n with context against the frozen tree only.

ROUTING FIDELITY verified against the overlay entrypoint script in the candidate tree lines 317-364 (route_resolve) read via git grep. Bash computes route from awk field 3 with default skill; the non-deployable first-segment test at 333-339 is gated on route != agent and fires when first_seg equals the whole path or equals engine; the dispatch at 345-361 is agent to agents/, elif opencode-agent to opencode/agents/, else to skills/. The critical UNKNOWN third-column case therefore falls through the else to the SKILL route. Go DeployableManifestPaths at engine/skills/ondisk.go:48-77 skips only the allow-list {agent, opencode-agent} at engine/skills/ondisk.go:29-33 and 60-62, so an unknown third column is retained as deployable, which MATCHES bash. The no-slash rule at engine/skills/ondisk.go:64-67 and the engine first-segment rule at engine/skills/ondisk.go:68-70 match lines 334-335. No routing false positive or false negative for any third-column value.

LIVE INVARIANT REPRODUCED BY HAND: listing the skills subtree of the candidate returns exactly 56 blobs, all mode 100644, with no symlinks, no submodules and no dot-prefixed segment anywhere. Reading overlay.manifest from the candidate gives 79 rows; applying the Go rules removes the 19 engine infra rows, the one root-level bookkeeping row that carries no path separator, the two rows whose third column selects the agent route, and the one row whose third column selects the opencode-agent route, leaving exactly 56 deployable rows. Both 56-element sets were compared element by element and are equal in both directions. TestRepositorySkillsAreFullyRegistered genuinely passes on this candidate rather than being green by accident.

DOT-FILE BLIND SPOT CHECKED: no manifest-deployed path contains a segment beginning with a dot, since the shared-contract directory is underscore-prefixed rather than dot-prefixed, so the dot-skip at engine/skills/ondisk.go:106-112 hides nothing the manifest deploys today.

DETERMINISM CHECKED: DiffOnDisk at engine/skills/ondisk.go:137-174 emits unregistered entries by iterating the diskPaths slice, which ScanSkillFiles returns sort.Strings-sorted, and the map-ranged manifestPaths side is buffered into missing and sort.Strings-sorted before emission. Output order is stable across Go's randomized map iteration. No determinism defect.

DRIFT GUARD NON-VACUOUS: git grep for headings shows Forbidden patterns (the gap) at skills/_shared/anti-generic-design.md:25 followed by Steer toward at :38, and at skills/anti-generic-design/SKILL.md:29 followed by Steer toward at :42, so the newline-hash-hash delimiter at engine/assets/assets_test.go:101 captures exactly the intended body with no over- or under-capture. A fixed-string grep returns exactly one hit per file, so strings.Index cannot latch onto a stray occurrence. Both sides are explicitly t.Fatalf-guarded against the empty string at engine/assets/assets_test.go:127-132. Word-by-word comparison of skills/_shared/anti-generic-design.md:27-36 against skills/anti-generic-design/SKILL.md:31-40 shows the only difference is line wrapping, which strings.Fields collapses, so the test passes for the right reason.

ANTI-MIMICRY TEST VERIFIED: git grep for the anti-mimicry line returns skills/anti-generic-design/SKILL.md:71 and skills/anti-generic-design/references/critique-template.md:16, exactly the two files asserted at engine/assets/assets_test.go:156.

COMPILE-SAFETY VERIFIED: git grep confirms Divergence with fields Class, Path and Detail at engine/skills/validate.go:23-26 and type DivergenceClass string at :9; the new constants UNREGISTERED_ON_DISK and MISSING_ON_DISK do not collide with the existing MISSING_IN_MANIFEST, MISSING_IN_REGISTRY, TAG_MISMATCH or MIXED_TAG names or values.

DEPLOY-PATH ENUMERATOR TRACED: parse_manifest at bin/labdrian-overlay:54-56 filters comments and blank lines, and all_tracked_files at :64-66 prints awk field 1 of every surviving line; done < <(all_tracked_files) at :730 closes the cmd_apply deploy loop that begins at :701. The comment and blank-line filters match Go's TrimSpace and hash-prefix rules; the field-count filter does not, which is finding 1.
